name: GhostCommandPalette
description: Headless command palette root: a GhostDialog shell composed with useGhostCombobox for grouped, consumer-filtered commands, keyboard highlight, loading and empty announcements, and a command event carrying the activated item id. Renders no element.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Requests close after a command is activated.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is omitted.

props.name: defaultSearch
props.description: Initial query and the value it resets to on close.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks opening, search, and command activation.

props.name: loading
props.description: Loading presentation: hides empty, sets `aria-busy`, announces loading.

props.name: messages
props.description: Overrides loading, empty, and results-count announcements.

props.name: modal
props.description: Modal shell (focus trap, scroll lock, inert background, overlay).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Omit for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: search
props.description: Controlled query text. Omit for uncontrolled mode.

events.name: command
events.description: Emitted synchronously with { id } when an enabled command is activated. Not cancelable; runs before any close request.

events.name: search
events.description: Emitted after each query change, including the reset on close, with a monotonic requestId for stale-response guards.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Palette parts composed by the consumer.

exposed.name: close
exposed.description: Requests close; a controlled parent may keep it open.

exposed.name: focusInput
exposed.description: Moves focus to the command input when it is mounted.

parts.name: content
parts.description: Dialog surface from GhostCommandPaletteContent; hosts the polite announcer.

parts.name: empty
parts.description: Message from GhostCommandPaletteEmpty when open, not loading, and no items are registered.

parts.name: announcer
parts.description: Visually hidden polite live region inside the content.

states.name: open
states.description: Trigger and input data-state while the palette is open.

states.name: active
states.description: Item data-state (and data-highlighted) for the keyboard or pointer highlight.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Item data-state when it cannot be highlighted or activated.

keyboard.ArrowDown: Highlights the next enabled command (wraps) and updates aria-activedescendant on the input.
keyboard.Enter: Activates the highlighted command: emits command with its id and, with closeOnSelect, closes. Never commits a selection or rewrites the query.
keyboard.Escape: Clears the highlight and closes the palette when closeOnEscape is true; focus returns to the opener.
keyboard.Tab: Cycles within the modal palette; in a non-modal palette, leaving the palette closes it without restoring focus.
keyboard.Shift+Tab: Cycles backward within the modal palette; in a non-modal palette, leaving closes it like Tab.
